evidence_quote: Patients. Three patients homozygous for Tangier disease (A. Bo., a 56-yr-old man; J. Si., a 42-yr-old man; and E. Ga., a 46-yr-old woman, sister of J. Si.) were donors of the Tangier plasma.
The patient, a 38-yr-old male, is the 18th reported case of Tangier disease, and was the subject of a recent case report (8).
note: Tissue lipid study of one previously reported patient; some individual clinical data (lipids, splenectomy for hypersplenism).

evidence_quote: Patients. Five patients homozygous for Tangier disease (C.N., T.L., P.L., E.G., and J.S.) were donors of the Tangier plasma.
note: Close call: individual data are per-patient HDL biochemistry only; clinical details are in earlier reports.

note: Counted only the two homozygous propositi (J. S., E. G.); heterozygous relatives are carriers, not Tangier disease.

evidence_quote: Study subjects. Seven patients homozygous for Tangier disease from five unrelated kindreds were studied.

evidence_quote: A 52-yr-old man (O.P.) was referred to the Ospedale Maggiore, University of Milan, because of a syringomyelia-like syndrome.
note: Mainly an in vitro plasma enzyme study, but the Tangier patient is described clinically; no variant reported.

evidence_quote: Patients 1 and 2 represent the two original cases as described by Fredrickson et al. (1), and patient 3 was originally described by Hoffman et al. (29).
note: Metabolic study of 3 Tangier homozygotes with per-patient lipid data in Table I; previously reported patients, no genotype (pre-gene era).

evidence_quote: Human fibroblasts were obtained from skin explants from 2 normal (non-TD) subjects and 3 patients with homozygous TD (referred to as TD1, TD2, and TD3).
note: Mainly a gene-identification and cell study, but ABC1 variants are reported for each of TD1, TD2 and TD3; TD3 also described clinically.

evidence_quote: 62歲の男性．角膜輪，冠動脈硬化症，鎖骨下動脈硬化症，腹部·下肢閉塞性動脈硬 化症を呈した家族性低HDL血症と糖尿病を合併した症例を経験した.
note: Japanese text; the single patient has familial low HDL (HDL-C 28 mg/dl) with an ABCA1 exon 4-skipping transcript, not Tangier disease.

evidence_quote: Genetic analyses revealed a homozygotic mutation in ABCA1 at the 913 amino acid position, where K(AAG) was converted into a stop codon (TAG).
V naší práci popisujeme prvního pacienta s homozygotní formou Tangierské nemoci v České republice.
note: Main text in Czech (English abstract only); describes one compound heterozygous ABCA1 patient.

evidence_quote: This variant is shared by all three family members PID1-PID3, conÞ rming its segregation in the family, and being in line with dominant inheritance of primary hypoalphalipoproteinemia.
note: Three heterozygous ABCA1 carriers (ABCA1 +/wt) with combined hypolipidaemia/hypoalphalipoproteinaemia; no one presented as having Tangier disease.
